verdict.rationale: PostHog exposes a full OpenAPI 3.0 spec at posthog.com/openapi.json (confirmed live via probe), plus per-endpoint OpenAPI specs for Endpoints that can generate typed SDK clients, documented in posthog-docs-45/posthog-supp-endpoints-openapi. missing for 10: independent third-party corroboration of spec completeness/usability beyond PostHog's own docs and probes.
